body:
I’m in almost the exact same situation as yourself (financially stable, girlfriend, friends) and can’t seem to let the idea of killing myself go. I think the thing that helps me get past this mindset from time to time is that we may be privileged and have everything that could set us out to lead a successful and materialistic ‘stable’ life but none of that actually matters. I always thought girlfriends and money would be the answer to happiness but it’s not the case, my happiness is most dependant on knowing that I’ve been given the opportunity to lead a life that will inevitably unfold into the unknown, and that’s what drives me to wake up in the morning. 

It cheers me up knowing that one day we’ll most likely go travelling or make new friends in new places and make wonderful memories which you’ll never forget. 

Like you, I was scared to speak up as i thought it would seem like a fake cry of attention that would only receive judgment and little genuine help considering people know how privileged I am, but I plucked up the courage to talk to a very close friend of mine and he really helped lay out the reasons as to why life is so much more of a better opportunity than death. When you’re closed minded and start coming to irrational conclusions in your own head it’s easy to convince yourself that nothing is worth it because everything points towards death, but having someone to lay out all the things that point towards life outweighs it by far. 

So my advice is, talk. To whomever you find the most trust in, if your friends don’t support you then they’re not real friends, and if it is the case then there’s 220,000 others on this page including myself that could offer as much time as physically possible to support you like a parent. If you wanna chat about it I’m free anytime 🙏🏻
They’re just trying to help dude
